routes.task: Review current generation, candidate quality, provenance, and gated export state.

routes.label: Process diagnose
routes.task: Diagnose current run state, process nodes, logs, queues, workers, and contracts.

routes.label: History compare
routes.task: Find a run, inspect result details, compare lineage, and confirm provenance.

routes.label: Lab heatmap
routes.task: Read factor heatmap, inspect selected cell meaning, and connect it to holdout proof.

routes.label: Workbench handoff
routes.task: Select a candidate, compare evidence, and understand review handoff state.

routes.label: Audit decision
routes.task: Understand decision state, OOS evidence, append-only ledger, and human decision input.

routes.label: Backtest edit/validate
routes.task: Select strategy/data, inspect or edit buy/sell conditions, validate, then review gated run and results.

routes.label: Replay investigate signal
routes.task: Choose source/date/symbol, preview bars/signals, manually start replay, and inspect the signal log.
